focused_question_template: Does the on-path call `{callee_name}` at path position {order} (static definition identity {static_status}; trace callee identity {trace_status}) fix or restrict the HOST of the outbound request to a value the attacker cannot choose, or can attacker influence still determine the destination host? Path, query, and request body content are OUT OF SCOPE -- answer only about HOST control.
established_meaning: modeled security property only (attacker controls the destination host of an outbound request; not a confirmed SSRF): reachability, network egress restrictions, allowlisting at the network layer, and actual internal-service impact are out of scope for this property
residual_vulnerability_questions: presence of an internal service actually reachable at attacker-chosen hosts
redirect-following and DNS-resolution effects on effective destination (explicitly out of scope for v1 -- host SYNTAX control, not effective destination control)
